stories.title: Auth: update_user and delete_user
stories.acceptance_criteria: Add update_user(user_id, username, display_name, role, password=None) and delete_user(user_id). delete_user must not allow deleting the current user (self). Returns (True, msg) or (False, msg).

stories.title: Manage Users UI: Edit and Delete
stories.acceptance_criteria: Per-user Edit button opens form (username, display_name, role, optional new password). Delete button with confirmation. Cannot edit or delete self.
